session: SESSION 03 — Autonomous AI Hero Production & Integration

creativeDirection.aesthetic: Apple Product Showcase × iOS 27 Glassmorphic Minimalism
creativeDirection.composition: Three floating translucent glass panels with depth, central panel elevated and prominent
creativeDirection.palette: Near-black obsidian background (#06070a - #0a0b0f), dark chromatic silk curves, platinum caustics

conceptEvaluations.verdict: Rejected (Overall luminance too dim, center prominence muted)
Rejected (Panels equally bright, lacks depth hierarchy, bottom area brighter than ideal for text)
Selected (Superior center focal prominence, deep #07080a bottom area giving optimal contrast for typography, exquisite squircle bevels and silk caustics)

prompt: Apple Keynote stage aesthetic meets iOS 27 minimalist spatial glass. Three floating glass slabs suspended in clean studio space on near-black obsidian background (#06070a). The central slab stands out distinctly with clean rounded corners (squircle), subtle edge refraction, and gentle soft lighting from above. Inside the three panels: elegant dark liquid chrome silk curves, soft platinum and dark graphite gradients, ultra-delicate caustic light refractions. Completely clean, ultra-refined, peaceful, luxurious. Absolutely NO text, NO numbers, NO logos, NO devices, NO mockup borders, NO neon. 16:9 widescreen landscape.

motionDesign.glassCaustics: highlight sheen pulsing in sync with ambient drift
motionDesign.loopIntegrity: Zero jump / frame 240 smoothly matches frame 0 in displacement and velocity
